evidence.quote:
## Interpretation

This closes the missing step between GDT602's oracle-segmented key recovery and
a genuinely end-to-end control. A verbose homophonic P+S cipher can be broken
from token strings and language order when its architecture and capacities are
known.

It is not yet a Voynich solution. Naibbe is a modern generator, its exact
published key already fails on the f84-free target in GDT601, and the real
manuscript has not supplied independent evidence for three 138-entry states or
six homophones per letter. The justified next action is an unchanged target
falsifier with held physical folios, restart agreement, multiple historical
language models and order-destroying nulls. Any attractive line that does not
survive those comparisons is pseudo-language, not a reading.

evidence.quote:
## Endinterpretation

Die 98-Unit-Schicht hat eine hierarchische, gerichtete Backoffstruktur:

```text
linke Komponente  -> linker Außenkontext + Initialtendenz
rechte Komponente -> rechter Außenkontext + Finaltendenz
exakte Merge-ID   -> Joint-/Standalone- und paarspezifische Residualrolle
```

Diese Architektur ist praktisch verwertbar: Für seltene tiefe Einheiten kann
die Komposition einen besseren formalen Backoff liefern als deren kleine eigene
Train-Stichprobe.  Sie rechtfertigt aber keine Stammübersetzung.  Besonders die
`o`-Familie verhindert einen einheitlichen Schlüssel: gleiche linke Komponente,
mehrere deutlich verschiedene held Rollen.  Der nächste Decoder darf
Komponentenprofile als geglätteten Prior verwenden, muss aber die exakte
Merge-Identität und Joint-Grenzabhängigkeiten erhalten.

reviewed_blocks.reason: Formal component backoff and exact merge identity, expressly not stem meanings.

reviewed_blocks.title: Concrete translation gain

evidence.quote:
## Concrete translation gain

The gain over the rejected generic prose is categorical. We no longer render
a line as “take material, do work, pass onward.” We can now recover bounded
claims with explicit values:

```text
qokaiin shaiin
hot, degree III; moist, degree III

chor daiin cthy
reproductive plant part: three measures; leaf material
```

The unknowns are visible rather than hidden: the exact plant term behind
`chor`, the unit selected by `d`, and the wider syntax around these clauses.
The next useful target is consequently `chol`, because it is the fixed
predecessor of every value in the only identical I–IV `d` frame. Resolving that
head can turn the current local amount phrase into a fuller ingredient or
record clause without reopening the already established value architecture.

reviewed_blocks.reason: The first example has an exact existing proposition. The second names the part/quantity/next-part relation and is not made addressable by its constituent meanings alone; retain one scoped phrase, not three new word meanings.
